title: interest on reserves / fed operating framework / money market floor | Balance Sheet Update | Interest on Reserve Balances (IORB)
summary: The Interest on Reserve Balances (IORB) rate remained at 3.65% on 2026-04-17, unchanged from the prior observation. The rate has been flat at 3.65% for at least five consecutive business days, reflecting the current Fed Funds target range upper bound and indicating no recent changes to the Fed's reserve remuneration policy.
